description: This file appears to be a PHP class definition for a controller managing fraud detection via DDoS monitoring in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for listing DDoS IPs, reporting, installing, uninstalling, and saving configurations.

classes.name: Ddos
classes.description: Controller class for managing DDoS fraud detection configurations and reports within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the main view for the DDoS fraud extension.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the DDoS fraud extension via POST data, returning a JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the DDoS fraud extension by calling the install method of its model if the user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the DDoS fraud extension by calling the uninstall method of its model if the user has permission.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates a report listing DDoS IPs with pagination, including links to filter by IP address and detailed IP info views.

methods.name: Ip
methods.description: Encapsulates functionality for reporting and listing DDoS IP addresses involved in attacks.
